newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Forecast Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds/Bonos.
newsitem.headline: Forecast Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds/Bonos.

text.p: The following is a daily forecast of yield spreads of Portuguese fixed rate bonds (OTs) against Bonos and Bunds.
Spread Feb 2007 OTs vs Jul 2007 Bund 50/51.4/52 vs 50 bp
Feb 2007 OTs vs Mar 2007 Bono -12/-15.2/-20 vs -17 bp
Feb 2007 OTs vs Mar 1999 OTs 105/109/113 vs 106 bp

Jun 97 future BPDOTM7 (0758 GMT) +0.05 points to 109.30 Main factors that could influence trade: German and Spanish bonds, the main references for OTs, are inching lower, and OTs could remain little changed relative to Bunds. Shorter Portuguese bonds are expected to show strongest support, dealers said.
